author: beehive state news
title: Kihei Akina named to 2025-26 Fred Haskins Award postseason watchlist
text:
Kihei Akina was named to the 2025-26 Fred Haskins Award Postseason Watchlist presented by Stifel, according to an announcement on May 6 by Golfweek, Golf Channel and The Back of the Range.
The Haskins Award is given each year to the most outstanding male collegiate golfer in the United States. It is considered one of college golf’s top honors. Named after teaching professional Fred Haskins, the award has been presented since 1971.
Akina had a standout season during his freshman campaign, winning two tournaments: the R.E. Lamkin and Bridgestone Collegiate Invitational titles in consecutive events. He finished with a scoring average of 68.92 and achieved two runner-up finishes, seven top-five finishes, and ten top-ten finishes in twelve tournaments this season. Akina currently ranks No. 6 in NCAA Scoreboard player rankings and No. 29 on the World Amateur Golf Ranking (WAGR).
He is notable as the only freshman among fifteen men’s golfers selected for this year’s watchlist and one of just two players from Big 12 schools; Oklahoma State’s Preston Stout also made the list after winning the Big 12 Championship.
The top ten finalists for this honor will be announced Friday, May 22. Voting for the winner will take place from then until June 1 at the end of stroke play in the NCAA Championship. Additionally, all ten finalists and their coaches are invited to attend Haskins Honors at Grand Blanc Maison on Wednesday, May 27.
